arguments.predicate_call: (rdi = obj, rsi = element record pointer at rsp+0x40, rdx = element record pointer at rsp+0x50, rcx = group index i as signed 32-bit, r8d = element index r12 when i == 0 else -1)

callees_not_modelled.predicate_0x5f6d600: called once per element consultation with (obj, rsi, rdx, rcx = group index, r8d = element index when group == 0 else -1); a nonzero result skips the element, a zero result appends it to the scan list. The predicate's own semantics are pinned by the RE-001 later-group predicate item and are NOT re-claimed here; the model takes predicate results as an oracle input

pass.note: the sole direct call is inside the pipeline prologue 0x5f884b0 (its site 0x5f88533, in the flag-clear arm that runs the pass before tail-jumping to the wrapper at 0x5f88550); the pass is never tail-jumped to and never referenced through a function-pointer slot

predicate.note: this pass's site is 0x5f6d7e1; the other site is inside the 0x5da5100 function, which inverts the result (xor $0x1) and is recorded as a site only

object_layout.cursor: obj+0x30, inline group-slot count; the native total is this value plus the heap group-slot count
object_layout.group_heap: obj+0xc0 (begin) / obj+0xc8 (end), 16-byte group slots (limit, element base) for groups 8 and up
object_layout.group_inline: qword at obj+0xb8, pointer to the eight 16-byte group slots (limit, element base) for groups 0..7
object_layout.scan_heap: obj+0xdc0 (begin) / obj+0xdc8 (end) / obj+0xdd0 (capacity end), 16-byte scan records (group index as 32-bit, element+0x28)
object_layout.scan_inline: qword at obj+0xdb8, pointer to the eight 16-byte scan records; the scan count lives at obj+0xd30

return_value: void; the scan list at obj+0xd30 / obj+0xdb8 / obj+0xdc0 is extended in place with one record per predicate-false element, in consultation order

semantics.append: a predicate-false element appends the 16-byte record (group index i as a 32-bit value, element+0x28) to the scan list: to the first scan array at the base pointer (qword at obj+0xdb8) + count*16 while the scan count <= 7, otherwise to the heap vector, growing it when end == capacity end (capacity 1 when empty, else twice the size, capped at 0x7ffffffffffffff records; growing at the maximum throws the native length error with the rodata string at 0x43d55a; the old buffer is freed when non-null and the new begin/end/capacity end are stored)
semantics.element_records: the element consulted at group i, counter r12 is the 0x50-stride slot at element_base + r12*0x50, where element_base is the group slot's second qword; the predicate receives rsi = (element+0x30, element+0x38 - 8 wrapping) and rdx = (element+0x40, element+0x48 - 8 wrapping)
semantics.group_loop: the iteration total is cursor + heap group-slot count, recomputed from the object at every outer advance; a total of 0 returns at once with no predicate call. Group i uses inline slot i when i <= 7 (unsigned), else heap slot i - 8. The loop ends when the next group index reaches the total (unsigned compare)
semantics.inner_loop: inside group i the counter r12 starts at 0 and the element offset starts at 0; each consultation advances both (r12 += 1, offset += 0x50) whether the predicate returns true or false, and the loop continues while r12 < limit (unsigned), where limit is the group slot's first qword. A predicate-true element is skipped with no record; a predicate-false element appends its record and the loop continues
semantics.predicate_arguments: the predicate is called with rcx = group index i and r8d = r12 when i == 0 (the native code moves r12d into r8d only on the inline path when the group index is 0) and r8d = -1 otherwise (the heap path, taken only for i > 7, always passes -1)

unknowns: The predicate 0x5f6d600's own decision rule is not modelled here; the model treats predicate results as oracle inputs, exactly as the native loop consults them.
Whether the predicate mutates the object (the pass re-reads the heap vector and the cursor at every outer advance) is not pinned; the model treats the group array as stable across one call.
The pipeline prologue 0x5f884b0's flag arm that decides whether the pass runs at all is not modelled; the sole caller site 0x5f88533 is recorded as a site only.

pass.identity: filter pass: per-group element scan consulting the later-group predicate, appending predicate-false elements to the scan list
